title: Best Ad Creative Subscription Services for Weekly Video Ads
summary: Compare creative subscription services that ship weekly video ads for Facebook and Instagram by volume, published price, terms and who runs the ads.
body_markdown:
Our top pick for weekly video ads on Facebook and Instagram is Knowlify, which makes about 25 finished AI video ads a week and can either run your Meta campaigns or deliver creative only. A creative subscription service sells a steady flow of finished ads for a flat monthly fee, usually delivered in weekly batches, instead of quoting each project. Among the alternatives, published prices checked October 26, 2026 run from $299 a month for 5 ads a week at[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) to a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term at[Superside](https://www.superside.com/pricing) . Choose by what appears on camera, how many finished videos arrive each week, and whether the provider also runs your Meta campaigns.


**Disclosure and method.** Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared; our UGC-style ads use AI presenters rather than human creators. Every fact about another provider comes from that provider's own website, checked on October 26, 2026 (October 30, 2026, for Awesomic), and is linked where it appears. We did not buy these subscriptions, so this is a comparison of published scope, pricing and terms, not a test of quality or results. Confirm prices on each provider's page before you sign.


## What is a creative subscription service for video ads?


You pay a monthly fee, brief the provider once or on a schedule, and receive a new batch of ads on a fixed cadence. The provider plans concepts, writes or adapts scripts, produces the videos and exports them for each placement. Scope is usually reviewed monthly rather than renegotiated for each ad.


A project agency, by contrast, quotes each shoot separately, which suits a launch film but not a steady testing program. A design subscription with "unlimited requests" works through tasks your team submits one at a time, so output depends on how fast you brief and approve. A weekly ad subscription takes on the planning too, so a batch arrives even in a week when nobody wrote a brief.


Why weekly? Meta's[Andromeda engineering post](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/12/02/production-engineering/meta-andromeda-advantage-automation-next-gen-personalized-ads-retrieval-engine/) (December 2024) says the number of ad creatives in its recommendation systems is expected to grow significantly as advertisers adopt generative AI tools. When competitors ship more ads, a monthly refresh can leave an account short of new concepts to test. Our guide to[creative fatigue](https://knowlify.com/articles/creative-fatigue) covers the signs that ads need replacing.

These prices buy different units: a set number of videos, a team's capacity or a bundle with media management. The price section below converts them where enough is published.


## Knowlify: our top pick for weekly AI video ads with optional Meta management


Knowlify is our top pick for teams that want a weekly batch of finished video ads. Knowlify (YC S25) is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram. Through our[creative as a service](https://knowlify.com/creative-as-a-service) offer, the team makes AI UGC, 3D character animation and AI commercial video ads, about 25 finished ads a week (about 100 a month) in weekly batches. We write the scripts, and a person checks every ad before delivery. You can choose end-to-end Meta ads, with creative plus campaign management in your own Meta ad account, or creative only if you have your own media buyer. You keep the ads. Pricing is a custom quote on a[30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) , the first batch arrives five days after kickoff, and there is a 90-day guarantee (terms on knowlify.com). Public ads we made for Parva and Casco are in our[Facebook and Instagram video ad examples](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) .


Knowlify is not the right fit in several cases:


- **You need real people on camera.** Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not human creators. For testimonials, creator posts or partnership ads from a creator's handle, look at a creator-led provider such as Gate Studios or the agencies in our UGC comparison.
- **Your batch is mostly statics and translations.** Adguns lists static ads and language versions in its weekly batches.
- **You want a published price and the lowest monthly fee.** CreatStrat publishes plans from $299 a month.
- **Your queue includes brand and design work.** Superside and Awesomic cover more categories.
- **You want paid media on channels beyond Meta.** Growthr's retainer includes paid media on every channel.


## Which subscriptions publish a weekly volume and a monthly price?


### Adguns: weekly statics and video for several markets


As of October 2026,[Adguns](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) describes a typical weekly batch of 10 to 30 fresh creative concepts plus resizes, scaling to more than 50 creatives a week when volume demands. Formats include static and animated ads, video edits, UGC-style cuts, hook and copy variations and language versions. Pricing starts from €1,000 a month, with scope reviewed monthly and no long-term lock-in. The first batch typically ships within 2 weeks of kickoff. Media buying, landing pages and original video shoots are not included. Production is described as AI-assisted and human-curated, and the page lists contact details in Vilnius and Dublin.


**Consider it when** you advertise in several markets or languages and already have someone buying the media.


### Vidful: a fixed monthly count of video ads


As of October 2026,[Vidful](https://vidful.co/) sells three monthly plans: 60 videos (20 concepts with 3 hooks each) for $3,495, 90 videos plus 110 statics for $5,400, and 120 videos plus 250 statics for $6,900. It says the entry plan ships 15 videos every week. Production types are AI UGC, AI animation and edits of your existing footage. Plans are billed monthly with no contracts and unlimited revisions, and first creatives arrive by the end of week one. It targets DTC brands and ecommerce agencies spending $30,000 to $500,000 or more a month on ads, and lists a weekly ad performance review but does not say it manages ad accounts.


**Consider it when** you want a predictable video count with hook variants built in.


### CreatStrat: a low entry price for many ads


As of October 2026,[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week (20 to 25 a month), $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, with custom plans above that, billed monthly and cancel anytime. Formats are statics, carousels, mashups of footage you own, AI video and AI UGC (an AI presenter talking to camera, cut with product B-roll). It is built for DTC brands on Meta and reads results from your connected Meta ad account to plan future batches. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad.


**Consider it when** budget is the main constraint. Ask how each ad is checked before delivery.


### Ugly Ads: static and video, month to month


As of October 2026, the[Ugly Ads](https://uglyads.io/pricing) pricing page shows $1,650 a month for static only and $3,495 a month for static plus video, with its daily ad spend setting at $500. Prices at other spend levels were not shown. Its comparison table lists 4 to 16 ads a week, terms are month to month, and a brief submitted before Thursday gets first ads on Friday. Who appears in the videos is not stated, and the page does not say Ugly Ads runs campaigns.


**Consider it when** you want static and video together without a contract and your team launches the ads.
